metadata.description: A Claude Code SDLC harness: the skills and hooks that make every repo work the same way, with GitHub Issues as the tracker.

plugins.name: sdlc-harness
plugins.description: GitHub Issues-first, trunk-based SDLC: /ticket, /spec, /build, /ship, plus git's pre-push judge that enforces green tests, no secrets, no closing keywords, and the agent-needs-go approval on protected paths for the exact commits each push sends.
